name: Test
oneLiner: Define done as checks before calling the work finished.
goal: The engineer names the checks. The agent does not invent the finish line.

steps.title: Name the checks
steps.text: Write what a person can observe when the work is done, including the widths and the states that matter.

doneChecks.text: The change's definition of done lists observable checks before the build starts.

pitfalls.text: Treating a green run as proof the result is right.

optionGroups.label: Done-checks
optionGroups.help: Pick every check this change has to meet.

options.label: 540px layout
options.promptFragment: Done check: at 540px wide there is no horizontal scrolling, and the detail region is a bottom sheet at half the viewport by default.

options.label: Wide layout
options.promptFragment: Done check: at 1440px wide the detail region is the right half of the page by default, and the work stays usable beside it.

options.label: Accessibility
options.promptFragment: Done check: every action works from the keyboard, focus is visible, and text on the application chrome meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1). https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html

options.label: Localization
options.detail: Strings still resolve after the change.
options.promptFragment: Done check: user-visible strings still go through this project's localization path. Add no hard-coded copy on a second path.

options.label: Copy feedback
options.detail: Tick and toast, red error on failure.
options.promptFragment: Done check: copying plain text shows a tick and a toast, and a failed copy shows a red error that includes the browser's message.

options.label: Keyboard
options.promptFragment: Done check: the keyboard shortcuts work and the ? overlay lists the same set.

optionGroups.label: Test types
optionGroups.help: Skip this when the change needs no new tests.

options.label: Unit tests
options.detail: xUnit for C#, Vitest for Vue.
options.promptFragment: Add or update unit tests. xUnit for C#: https://xunit.net/docs/getting-started/v3/getting-started. Vitest for Vue: https://vitest.dev/guide/.

options.label: End-to-end tests
options.promptFragment: Add or update Playwright tests at 540px and 1440px, with screenshots. https://playwright.dev/docs/intro
